title: Performance campaign initialization treated an empty target-era phase lane set as a null phase

source_observation.environment: Exact immutable 2.5.5 archive on trusted Factorio 2.0.77 after all package, engine, and harness preflights
source_observation.fact: The governed 2.0 campaign has no compiler phase lanes. Initialization expanded phaseLanes.probe_phase to a null array entry and used it as an ordered-dictionary key, raising 'Index operation failed; the array index evaluated to null' before the first Factorio lane.

reproducer.expected: A governed campaign with no phase lanes runs its ordinary package and compatibility lanes without inventing a null phase; a campaign with phase lanes retains complete phase measurement.
reproducer.observed: The raw campaign capsule was created with zero lanes and the runner terminated before Factorio launch with an array-index error.

closure.evidence: Phase sample initialization now uses only explicit non-empty declared phases; exact 2.0 and 2.1 performance proofs plus hosted exact-head proof remain required.
